title: First-layer gate output probability
statement: For every depth circuit on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and every gate in its first layer, the uniform probability that the gate's output differs from the neutral value of the dual gate equals $2^{-w}$, where $w$ is the width of that gate's term.
hypotheses_covered: A depth circuit on that dimension
